items.title: perf(ci): overlap the isolated survivor Doctor proof
items.summary: perf(ci): overlap the isolated survivor Doctor proof Run the formerly bundled plugin Doctor proof alongside the existing already-current and service restart checks. It owns separate state, config, workspace, port and registry; the shared candidate package remains immutable. Join its result before rollback/success and cancel and drain it before shared dependency cleanup. Await nested registry admission before using its child or closing the inherited log descriptor. Local Linux ARM64, same published 2026.10.2 baseline, exact hosted candidate, 43-plugin registry, image, 16 CPUs and 8 GiB: post-update block 87.461 -> 59.437 seconds, saving 28.024 seconds (32.0%). The independent proof took 30.251 seconds within that block. Full scenario 757.481 -> 706.003 seconds; 26.325 seconds of that difference was unrelated updater variance, not claimed as this change's benefit. Hosted baselines: runs 38794323475 and 38802524013. The next natural hourly supplies the hosted measurement; no CI was triggered. Preserve real baseline/companion installation, candidate update and schema migration, authenticated service restart, cron ownership, state/transcript survival, candidate agent turn, no-op/service checks, clean Doctor, stale-latest Doctor cohort repair without fabricated consent, and backup rollback. Proof: full real Docker scenario passed; focused lifetime/rollback and routing/ diagnostics contracts passed; failure-propagation and asynchronous-startup negative controls failed as intended; root test types, targeted lint/format, Bash syntax and P2 review passed. No jobs, runner, deadline, retry or coverage changes. Total scenario work is preserved; only independent work overlaps.
